name: Ryu
source:
A youth with special powers that lives in the village of Camel.
His father is the famous adventurer, Roy.
Roy disappeared on an adventure when Ryu was a child so the village chief raised him.
He is serious, sincere and has the friendly streak of a gullible country boy.
He leaves the village to sell Aruba in the city and embarks on a quest for his father.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071210142828/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dragonia/p_cha01.html]official site[/url]]
